use_cases: Evaluate a parameter that may be a callable or a static value
Conditionally invoke a function or return its raw value in TensorFlow utility code
Simplify lazy evaluation patterns where a config value might be a lambda
Handle both direct values and callable factories uniformly in optimization code
Reduce boilerplate when a parameter can be either a constant or a function

examples.use_call_if_callable: use call_if_callable to evaluate a param that may be a callable or static value
examples.test_call_if_callable: test call_if_callable with a lambda and a plain integer to verify both branches
examples.refactor_call_if_callable: refactor call_if_callable to add type hints and docstring for better discoverability
examples.review_call_if_callable: review call_if_callable to confirm it safely handles None and non-callable types
examples.summarize_call_if_callable: summarize call_if_callable as a utility that returns param() if callable else param
